Waterfront re-audit lead: stored 'riverview'; Campspot's 'Creekside Back-In FHU' type (26 sites) is described 'Enjoy a site alongside Big Cedar Creek!' and the park lists the 'Waterfront' feature. Big Cedar Creek is ~25 m wide here (creekside vocabulary); on imagery the RV rows run along the creek road behind a thin tree belt.
Pin: 34.13346,-85.30795 sits by the office/field; the RV rows start ~250 m WNW along the creek (about 34.1345,-85.3103) and may run further west. Suggest moving the pin onto the RV rows.
Long-stay: Campspot sells long-term stays too (28+ night policies, utilities billed monthly), but one night sells on both RV types, so test 2 passes.
